about_the_game:
Welcome to Brickhaven

Brickhaven is the very city you and your gang fight to thrive in. Explore the busy streets, check out the shops, and find some lucrative opportunities along the way. 

The Empire

  • Recruit your members right off the street

  • Setup protection rackets, drug fronts, money laundering schemes, and much more to help maximize your profits

  • Send members to defend your hard earned rackets and businesses in order to set a physical footprint in the city

  • Be as hands off or on as you want, almost everything can be automated through delegation

Rule the Streets

  • Fight off rival gangs moving in on your turf

  • Send gang members to attack rival businesses

  • Take over the enemy turf to continue your expansion

Delegate

  • Order members to rob civilians, hold up a store, or even do a drive by

  • Setup runners for your rackets to make cash drops at the gang stash

  • Appoint members as dealers, guards of a business, to patrol routes, or even assign them as lieutenants to help you run your empire 

Surviving the Police

  • Create enough noise and the cops will catch on fast

  • Survive police raids on warehouses or bribe the chief in order to keep them off your back

  • Take out enough cops in an area and they may end up being too scared to come back for a quite a while

Engage In Turf Wars Online and Off

  • Multiplayer mode where up to five players can join and all create their own separate gangs. Each player will start off with no money and no gang. They will then have to carefully build up their crews and strategically setup turf defense measures in order to maintain their foothold.

  • There will be the ability to create fragile alliances as well as give businesses and turf up to rivals in order to avoid being crushed

  • A solo mode will also be available for players who want to go up against the AI gangs

Houses / Apartments 

  • Players and NPCs will have their own homes and apartments

  • Each residence will be available for you to break into and rob. That goes for players too, so watch your back

  • Players will be able to purchase homes and customize them with furniture, have gang members hang out at the crib, or make it your place away from the streets depending on where you reside

  • Player homes will not be made publicly available, so in order to figure out where a player lives, they either need to show you or you need to have them followed back to their home 

Dynamic World

  • Each NPC will have their own jobs and schedules 

  • Depending on what your crew is up to, it could shape the whole neighborhood. Selling hard drugs? Could cause an epidemic in the turf. Selling heavy duty guns? Could see a rise in violence among the citizens and other crews in the area. 

Permadeath

  • Making one wrong decision could mean losing your top members forever or even your own life. When the boss of a gang is taken out, then you will take the role of the next strongest member in your gang who will then take over. Your gang isn't gone until the last member is taken out.

Run Your Gang Freely 

  • Choose how you want to run your gang. Want to run guns, but ban drugs from your turf? Make the order. Want to squeeze your rivals into submission instead of dividing up the city? Do it. Nobody can tell you how to run your crew, show us what you are made of!

content_descriptors.notes: We do not condone anything in these works. All experiences are for entertainment purposes only. Contains frequent violence and sexual themes.

short_description: Create your gang from nothing. Start off with just yourself and take it from a single member to a sprawling criminal empire. Extort businesses, deal drugs, sell guns, and much more. Customize your gang to partake in whatever crimes you want them to. What kind of boss will you be?
